chains.rationale: The frozen chain continuously extends the credential-field focus loop from reuse step 30 through the terminal trace, never obtaining authenticated Mattermost access. The evaluator reports the downstream omission "No email sent"; authenticated access was required to inspect project-updates and complete the reconciliation workflow leading to that email, providing an explicit indirect bridge. The earlier rejected-login defect and evaluator-reported email omission are sufficient alternatives, so the evidence supports plausible observed contribution rather than strong linkage.
